name: Hibernal-Nave
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are perpetual storm systems, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Extremophile bacteria thrive in the mineral seeps, painting slow, living terraces.
the temporal distortion zone bends the local reality in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Whoever solves this anomaly will rewrite several sciences. Whoever blunders into it will merely end several careers.
